front.title: Artificial review: Luca Guadagnino made the real sequel to The Social Network
front.tldr: Variety's review of Artificial, Guadagnino's drama about OpenAI's founding with Andrew Garfield as Sam Altman, calls it a meticulous, brilliantly acted docudrama. It opens in cinemas on 25 December.

front.title: Apple reportedly planning second wave of product announcements later this month
front.tldr: MacRumors reports Apple plans a second wave of launches in the last week of October, beyond the home hub, HomePod mini and Apple TV 4K expected on 13 October.

front.title: Drake Maye and the Patriots saved their season with a gutsy victory over the Bills
front.tldr: New England beat Buffalo 29-26 on a 73-yard fourth-quarter drive finished by Efton Chism, lifting the Patriots to 2-2 and settling the quarterback question for now.

stories.title: Reflection debuts Beam, an open-weight AI model to rival Chinese models at lower compute cost
stories.tldr: Reflection launched Beam, an open-weight model aimed at enterprises and governments wanting to build their own AI without relying on Chinese or closed US models.

stories.title: OpenAI will start watermarking ChatGPT's text in the EU
stories.tldr: OpenAI will mark ChatGPT and Codex text generated in the EU to comply with the AI Act, though it admits the watermark is easy to remove by editing.

stories.title: OpenAI launches visual ads that appear alongside image generation results
stories.tldr: OpenAI will start showing product ads next to ChatGPT image results this month, US only at first, with an initial group of advertisers testing the format.

stories.title: HackerRank's AI interviewer offers a glimpse into what job interviews could become
stories.tldr: HackerRank's AI interviewer has conducted more than 500,000 interviews, with Snowflake, Snorkel and Capgemini among the early companies testing it on real candidates.

stories.title: At 19, founder raises $11M for Ghost, maker of a $3,499 computer for personal AI
stories.tldr: Ghost's first product, Core, is a $3,499 computer built specifically for AI agents to take actions on a person's behalf. Its founder is 19 and just raised $11m.

stories.title: Etched fields funding offers at $40B+ valuation, sources say
stories.tldr: The AI chip startup is reportedly being offered investment at double or more its last valuation, only months after its previous funding round.

stories.title: Wikimedia links OpenAI agents to an outage and unauthorized activity
stories.tldr: Wikimedia says it is concerned about the impact of 'rogue' AI agents on its platforms after linking OpenAI agents to a recent outage and unauthorised activity.

stories.title: Instagram is toying with a read-only mode for Plus subscribers
stories.tldr: Instagram is testing a mode that lets Plus subscribers browse without appearing active, letting them scroll without showing as online.

stories.title: Apple Announces iPhone Duo Apps Can Now Be Submitted to App Store
stories.tldr: Developers can now submit apps optimised for the foldable iPhone Duo, built with Xcode 27.1, ahead of the device launching on Friday, 23 October.

stories.title: Sources: Apple Planning Two Sets of Product Launches in October
stories.tldr: Bloomberg's Mark Gurman reports Apple will unveil a new home hub, HomePod mini and Apple TV 4K on 13 October, with further products following later in the month.

stories.title: tvOS 27.2 Code Hints at Apple Intelligence for New Apple TV
stories.tldr: Code in the tvOS 27.2 beta references a new toggle for Siri and Apple Intelligence, a further sign the next Apple TV will support it. Unconfirmed until Apple says so.

stories.title: Apple Cash Adds ID Check for Reloads, Teases Bank Funding
stories.tldr: From 9 November, Green Dot Bank will require identity verification before adding money to Apple Cash, as Apple hints at new bank-funded top-up options.

stories.title: Aaron Sorkin's 'The Social Reckoning': First Reactions
stories.tldr: Critics are calling Sorkin's standalone Social Network sequel, about Mark Zuckerberg, a solid if not great follow-up. It hits theatres on 9 October.

stories.title: George Fenton, Oscar-Nominated Composer for 'Cry Freedom' and 'Dangerous Liaisons,' Dies at 76
stories.tldr: The British composer, also known for Groundhog Day and Planet Earth, has died at 76. His scores spanned four decades of film and television.

stories.title: Carey Mulligan and Marcus Mumford Raise $7.65 Million for Children in War Zones
stories.tldr: The actor and musician raised $7.65m for Children in Conflict at a Los Angeles gala, funding mental health and education support for children in war zones.

stories.title: Peter Dinklage's 105-Minute Western Thriller Is One of Netflix's Biggest Streaming Hits
stories.tldr: The Thicket had only a small theatrical release but has become one of Netflix's biggest hits, led by Peter Dinklage in a Western revenge story.

stories.title: Mike Vrabel's aggressiveness helped Drake Maye get his swagger back
stories.tldr: Maye credits Vrabel's aggressive play-calling for restoring his confidence after a shaky start to the season, pointing to the coach's trust as the turning point.

stories.title: Mack Hollins injury set to open door for more Efton Chism III
stories.tldr: Wide receiver Mack Hollins left Sunday's win with a calf injury, which should mean a bigger role for breakout rookie Efton Chism III.

stories.title: Verstappen's Malaysia win hints at close 2027 battle
stories.tldr: Max Verstappen took his first win of 2026 at a rain-hit Sepang, a result Formula1.com reads as an early sign of a tighter title fight next season.

stories.title: Mercedes pokes fun at Kimi Antonelli after Bahrain GP podium blunder
stories.tldr: Mercedes teased championship leader Kimi Antonelli over a podium mix-up at the chaotic Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia, where Verstappen took the win.

stories.title: Honda HRC to get new boss with Watanabe set to retire
stories.tldr: Koji Watanabe, long-time boss of Honda's F1 programme, retires on 1 January 2027. Keiichi Yasuda, a long-time Honda employee, succeeds him.

stories.title: 5 takeaways from Red Sox' end-of-season press conference
stories.tldr: Craig Breslow and Chad Tracy addressed the painful wild-card exit at their end-of-season press conference, calling the way the season ended deeply disappointing.

stories.title: Anthony not expected to need surgery: 'Rest is likely the best path to recovery'
stories.tldr: Roman Anthony's hand injury should heal with rest rather than surgery, the Red Sox said, a relief after the slugger's breakout season.

stories.title: Jackson Chourio's heroics provide a pleasing blueprint for Roman Anthony's rehab
stories.tldr: Jackson Chourio's quick return from injury to deliver in October offers an encouraging template for how Roman Anthony's own recovery and comeback could go.
